Title: غزل آزمایشی ۱-۷
PoemSummary: Substring-false-positive case for Finding 3 of the external review: contains the compound word 'آینه‌بند' (mirror-frame-maker/binder, joined by ZWNJ) which SHARES the literal substring 'آینه' but is a different token, not an occurrence of the word 'mirror'. A naive substring matcher over-counts this as a mirror anchor hit; a token/ZWNJ-aware matcher (spec §58) must not. This poem must NOT appear in poems_with_mirror.

Sections.PlainText: آینه‌بند نو بر دیوار بستند / کاری خوش از دست هنرمند
